doc.brief: Animates the transition of its child from invisible to visible.
doc.md:
Animates the transition of its child from invisible to visible.

The style of transition can be controlled with
[`Revealer.set_transition_type()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Revealer#method:set_transition_type).

These animations respect the [`Settings:gtk-enable-animations`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Settings#property:gtk-enable-animations)
setting.

# CSS nodes

`GtkRevealer` has a single CSS node with name revealer.
When styling `GtkRevealer` using CSS, remember that it only hides its contents,
not itself. That means applied margin, padding and borders will be visible even
when the [`Revealer:reveal-child`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Revealer#property:reveal-child) property is set to `FALSE`.

# Accessibility

`GtkRevealer` uses the [`AccessibleRole.group`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleRole#value:group) role.

The child of `GtkRevealer`, if set, is always available in the accessibility
tree, regardless of the state of the revealer widget.

get_child_revealed.brief: Returns whether the child is fully revealed.
get_child_revealed.md:
Returns whether the child is fully revealed.

In other words, this returns whether the transition
to the revealed state is completed.

get_reveal_child.brief: Returns whether the child is currently revealed.
get_reveal_child.md:
Returns whether the child is currently revealed.

This function returns `TRUE` as soon as the transition
is to the revealed state is started. To learn whether
the child is fully revealed (ie the transition is completed),
use [`Revealer.get_child_revealed()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Revealer#method:get_child_revealed).

get_transition_duration.brief: Returns the amount of time (in milliseconds) that transitions will take.
get_transition_duration.md:
Returns the amount of time (in milliseconds) that
transitions will take.

get_transition_type.brief: Gets the type of animation that will be used for transitions in `revealer`.
get_transition_type.md:
Gets the type of animation that will be used
for transitions in `revealer`.

set_reveal_child.brief: Tells the `GtkRevealer` to reveal or conceal its child.
set_reveal_child.md:
Tells the `GtkRevealer` to reveal or conceal its child.

The transition will be animated with the current
transition type of `revealer`.

set_transition_duration.brief: Sets the duration that transitions will take.
set_transition_duration.md: Sets the duration that transitions will take.

set_transition_type.brief: Sets the type of animation that will be used for transitions in `revealer`.
set_transition_type.md:
Sets the type of animation that will be used for
transitions in `revealer`.

Available types include various kinds of fades and slides.

child-revealed.brief: Whether the child is revealed and the animation target reached.
child-revealed.md: Whether the child is revealed and the animation target reached.

reveal-child.brief: Whether the revealer should reveal the child.
reveal-child.md: Whether the revealer should reveal the child.

transition-type.brief: The type of animation used to transition.
transition-type.md: The type of animation used to transition.
